1722-2034-3583-7192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-7192.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

1479-1659-2841-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-1659-2841-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3661-3899-4053-6989.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-2921-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-2921-6578.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1170-2981-3581-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-3581-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

654-2693-4693-5721.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
654-2693-4693-5721.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Overgrown Estate repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
For each land that enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

280-4913-5310-7857.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2713-7365-7824.description:
Activate Katara by paying {4} due to Zirda, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-2713-7365-7824.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

2946-4871-5147-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5147-6248.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4659-5365-5494-7704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-7704.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4478-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

891-3055-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1818-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1818-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

4050-4896-7026.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine legendary enchantments.
4050-4896-7026.description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar nine times by sacrificing nine Spirits, adding {2}{W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Hei Bai.
Repeat.

141-413-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-413-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

1402-2644-4763-5295.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

880-3678-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3678-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2440-2534-4183-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter
2440-2534-4183-4720.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Coercive Recruiter for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5695-6019.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 3 and 7, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

3011-6093.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has an even life total.
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-6093.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing an amount of damage to each player equal to half their life total rounded down, except that the damage or life loss to opponents is doubled.
Each opponent who had an even life total loses the game due to having zero life.

1580-2018-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

628-3967-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-3967-5523.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1, causing it to gain indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

467-549-1912-1978-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
467-549-1912-1978-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

2281-2292-2732.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Saffi dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Saffi from your graveyard.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Saffi from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1530-3341.notablePrerequisites:
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Your life total is five or less.
1530-3341.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Second Chance to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

1286-3018-4050.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Rancor enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

702-1321-2825-4067.notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
At least two cards in your graveyard.
702-1321-2825-4067.description:
Activate Immortal Coil by tapping it and exiling two cards from your graveyard, drawing a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Immortal Coil.
Repeat the previous two steps until your graveyard is empty.
Immortal Coil's last ability triggers.
In response, activate Elite Arcanist by paying {4} and tapping it, casting and resolving a copy of Stunning Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Let the Immortal Coil trigger resolve, drawing seven cards and setting your life total to 1.
Immortal Coil's last ability triggers again.
In response, activate Mind Over Matter five times by discarding five cards, untapping Elite Arcanist and four lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {4}.
Let the Immortal Coil trigger resolve, drawing seven cards and setting your life total to 1.
Repeat until there are no cards in your library, activating Mind Over Matter by discarding a card additional times at any point if needed to adjust your library size and avoid drawing from an empty library.

1455-2743-2909.description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Biovisionary and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Repeat one additional time.
Cast Mind Games by paying {U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

192-1836.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six basic Forests and/or basic Snow Covered Forests.
192-1836.description:
Activate any basic Forest or Snow-Covered Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wakeroot Elemental by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}, untapping a basic Forest or Snow-Covered Forest and causing it to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land until end of turn.
Repeat.

651-3533-4046.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Sacrifice Task Force to Doomgape, gaining life equal to its toughness.
